tools.name: audit_business
tools.description: START HERE. One call: checks the Google profile name against the rules AND against the business's own website, benchmarks review count and rating against real Australian businesses in the same Google category, recommends the primary category from what real businesses in that trade use, audits the we

tools.name: find_google_profile
tools.description: Reads a business's website and pulls out every link to its Google Business Profile, with the Place ID or CID where the link carries one. Use this instead of asking the user to go and find their listing. If the site links to no profile at all, that is itself a finding worth reporting.

tools.name: read_site_reviews
tools.description: Pulls the rating, review count and individual reviews a business publishes on its own site through schema.org aggregateRating and Review markup. Use it to get a review count and rating without asking the user, then feed them to benchmark_business. Reports when a site publishes no review data at all,

tools.name: list_site_services
tools.description: Reads the website's sitemap (or its homepage links if there is no sitemap) and returns the service pages and suburb/area pages it has. Use it to work out which Services belong on the Google profile and whether the service area on the profile matches the suburbs the site actually covers.

tools.name: verify_business_name
tools.description: Checks a Google Business Profile name against Google's naming rules, then reads the business's own website to decide whether the flagged words are the genuine real-world brand (allowed) or were added to the listing for ranking (not allowed). Reads the site's title, schema.org markup, og:site_name, l

tools.name: benchmark_business
tools.description: Where a business actually sits against real Australian Google Business Profiles in the same Google primary category: review-count and star-rating percentiles, the gap to the median and the top quartile in reviews and in months, and how common a rule-breaking name is in that category. Built from Kang

tools.name: pick_gbp_category
tools.description: Returns the Google primary category real Australian businesses in a trade actually use, with the share that use each one, plus the additional categories worth adding. Replaces 'go search Maps and copy the top 3' with the answer. Primary category is the biggest ranking lever on a profile.

tools.name: check_business_name
tools.description: Checks a Google Business Profile name against Google's naming rules (no keywords, locations, taglines, phone numbers, hours). Keyword-stuffed names are the most common cause of suspensions. Returns PASS/RISK/FAIL, each problem with its fix, and the likely real name.

tools.name: check_gbp_description
tools.description: Checks a Google Business Profile description before it's saved: the 750-character limit, links, prices or promotions (not allowed), keyword stuffing, AI-style filler, missing area or services, and what shows before 'More'. Gives a four-block structure that works.

tools.name: check_gbp_post
tools.description: Checks a Google Business Profile post before publishing so it doesn't get rejected: phone numbers in the text (a top cause of silent rejections), link shorteners, contact details, all caps, gimmicky punctuation, regulated products, length. Returns fixes and a three-line post format that publishes re

tools.name: audit_gbp_profile
tools.description: Scores a Google Business Profile out of 100 from the details you give (categories, reviews and review recency, photos, services, products, posts, links, hours, service area) and returns a priority-ordered fix list. Weighted by what actually brings in calls. Unknown fields are listed for checking, ne

tools.name: build_review_link
tools.description: Turns a Google Place ID into a direct 'write a review' link that opens the review box, plus a printable QR code image. Catches the common mistake of using a CID or Maps ID instead of a Place ID.

tools.name: check_review_request
tools.description: Checks the SMS or email a business sends to ask for Google reviews against Google's review policy and the Australian Consumer Law: incentives, review gating (only asking happy customers), asking for 5 stars, scripting the review. Returns problems, fixes and a compliant template.

tools.name: check_review_reply
tools.description: Checks an owner's reply to a Google review before posting it: privacy leaks (addresses, invoice numbers, health details), offers to change a review, argumentative tone, generic one-liners, length. Gives advice suited to the star rating.

tools.name: suspension_triage
tools.description: For a suspended, disabled, unverified or limited Google Business Profile: ranks the likely causes from yes/no answers, says whether to appeal, re-verify or wait, and lists the evidence to gather plus a video verification shot list. Answer what you know and leave the rest out.

tools.name: audit_website_local_seo
tools.description: Fetches one public web page and checks its local SEO layer: title and H1 naming the service and area, click-to-call link, LocalBusiness schema, name and phone matching the Google profile, indexability, robots.txt, sitemap, mobile viewport, forms, review proof. Returns a score and a priority-ordered

tools.name: compare_nap
tools.description: Checks that a business's name, address and phone (NAP) match across directory listings, ignoring formatting differences (St vs Street, +61 vs 0, Pty Ltd). Paste each listing's details or text. Returns real mismatches and a list of Australian directories worth having.

tools.name: draft_spam_report
tools.description: Drafts a factual report about a competitor's Google listing that breaks the guidelines (keyword-stuffed name, fake address, duplicates, fake reviews, closed business), with where to send it and the evidence to attach. Only drafts the text. Nothing is submitted.

tools.name: optimisation_checklist
tools.description: Returns the full step-by-step Google Business Profile optimisation checklist an agency works through (categories, name, description, contact links, service area, hours, attributes, services, products, photos, reviews, posts, booking, website and citations), tailored to the trade and city.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_business, read_site_reviews, benchmark_business, check_gbp_post, audit_gbp_profile, check_review_request, check_review_reply, audit_website_local_seo · Private data: check_gbp_post, optimisation_checklist · Public sink: pick_gbp_category, check_gbp_post, check_review_request, draft_spam_report · Destructive: check_gbp_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_business, read_site_reviews, benchmark_business, check_gbp_post, audit_gbp_profile, check_review_request, check_review_reply, audit_website_local_seo · Private data: check_gbp_post, optimisation_checklist · Public sink: pick_gbp_category, check_gbp_post, check_review_request, draft_spam_report · Destructive: check_gbp_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
